equation_summary: Additive linear attention over a matrix state S[B,H,K,V]: per token S_t = S_{t-1} + k_t^T v_t and o_t = (q_t*scale) S_t, i.e. the read is AFTER the update. There is no decay (G=I). The optional normalized variant keeps a second cumulative-key state k_cum = cumsum(k) and divides o by ((q*scale) . k_cum + 1e-10). The feature map (elu/relu/hadamard/t2r/dpfp/identity) is applied to q,k externally before the call.
state_shape: [B,H,K,V] matrix; normalized variant adds a [B,H,K] cumulative-key (denominator) state
normalization: optional denominator-state with explicit epsilon (1e-10) division
ledger_verdicts: CONFIRM numerator = U2.A (plain additive, no decay, after-update read) matches naive_recurrent_linear_attn S = S + k^T v; o = (q*scale) S

CONFIRM the normalized variant is a denominator cumulative-key state plus external epsilon division, matching the ledger's `|| U2.A(denominator if normalized)` composition hint and the `E[epsilon division/output]` stage
CONFIRM blockers: denominator state, epsilon, read timing and B[K2_graph_execution] are exactly the open items
direction_justification: The mixer is exactly U2.A (G=I, additive, after-update read); normalization is a second U2.A denominator call plus external epsilon division, so no new core semantics beyond the K2 graph binder.
open_questions: The denominator state is a vector cumulative-key sum; whether it is admitted as a degenerate U2.A (v=1) call or a dedicated denominator-state descriptor is a binder-level decision the source does not force.
evidence_citations: fla/ops/linear_attn/naive.py:35-37 — S = S + einsum(k_t, v_t); o_t = einsum(S, q_t*scale): additive update, after-update read, no decay
fla/ops/linear_attn/naive.py:38-40 — normalized variant: k_cum = k.cumsum(1); o = o / ((q*scale*k_cum).sum(-1) + 1e-10): denominator state + explicit epsilon division
fla/layers/linear_attn.py:97-111 — elu/relu/hadamard/t2r/dpfp/identity feature map applied to q,k BEFORE the op call (external)
fla/layers/linear_attn.py:163-164 — feature_map_q(q), feature_map_k(k) are external frontend stages
